summary:
Iteration 71 — Live re-test of RoomTutorial / RoomCoach / wall-openings at 768x1024. The new testIDs (sketch-canvas, tool-polygon, tool-edit, point-move-only-toggle, line-measure-input, line-measure-commit, room-tutorial*, room-coach*, opening-*, wall-opening-*) MADE the flow scriptable — most items that were code-review-only in iter_70 are now live-verified.

LIVE-PASS (10 items):
- T1 RoomTutorial auto-start: tutorial appears exactly after first closed room (>=2.5s grace), 10 pages Schritt 1..10, Weiter/Zurück work, closing writes aufmassprofi_room_tutorial_done='1'. After full reload + drawing a new room the tutorial does NOT reappear (key honoured).
- T2a: room-tutorial-practice button inside the tutorial closes the modal and enters practice mode (room-coach visible, Elemente:0, Übung header).
- T2c: /sketches/draw?practice=1 directly opens the editor in practice mode with an empty sketch and the room-coach card.
- T3 Step 1 'Raum zeichnen': tool-polygon has the orange glow border (#ff6d00) during step 1; after closing a 4-corner polygon the coach advances to step 2 ('Linie anwählen') exactly on close (not earlier).
- T3 Step 2 'Linie anwählen': after switching to tool-edit and tapping a line midpoint the LineMeasurePanel opens and the coach advances to step 3.
- T3 Step 3 'Alle Seiten bemaßen': typing 4/3/4/3 into line-measure-input + line-measure-commit on each side advances the coach to step 4 exactly when all four segments carry a measurement (12,00 m² overview visible).
- T3 Step 4 'Eine Ecke verschieben': point-move-only-toggle shows the orange glow (box-shadow #ff6d00) during step 4 and dragging a corner advances the coach to step 5 on pointsKey change.
- T3 Step 5 'Diagonale eingeben': VERIFIED the app DOES auto-select the diagonal input field as the coach text claims — after step 4 the LineMeasurePanel re-opens with the 'Diagonalen angeben' accordion expanded and the diagonal input focused ('Ecke Linie 4/1 ↔ Ecke Linie 2/3'). Typing 5 + Enter advances the coach to step 6. (The iter_70 code-review concern on this point is REJECTED — the auto-focus works.)
- T3 Step 6 'Skizze geraderücken': tapping 'Skizze geraderücken' in the Mehr panel applies straightening (panel label flips to 'Skizze passt zu den Maßen' and the quadrilateral snaps to a 4x3 rectangle, 12,00 m²) and the coach advances to step 7.
- O1 insert door via long-press: real mouse-down + 900 ms hold + mouse-up on the top line opens the OpeningInsertMenu; tapping opening-insert-door inserts a 0,885 x 2,01 Tür with opening-marker-0-0 visible on the line and label 'T 0,885×2,01 →1,56' rendered next to it.

LIVE-FAIL (2 items, the two bugs reported in iter_70 are REPRODUCED live):
- O2 negative offset: typing '-0,5' into wall-opening-offset-0 is silently stored ('input_value'='-0,5', conflict=''). openingConflict() does NOT fire 'outside' for start<0; the opening is moved before the line start without any visual / textual error.
- O2 non-numeric text: typing 'abc' into wall-opening-offset-0 is stored as 'abc' (parseMeasurementToMeters → NaN), no user-visible hint. UX gap.

LIVE-CHECK (not a bug):
- O2 '3,80': wall-opening-conflict-0 reads 'Ragt über die Linie hinaus (Linie 4,00 m)' as expected.
- O2 '1.5' and '1,5' both accepted (parseMeasurementToMeters normalises comma vs dot). Good.

NOT-EXECUTED (6 items) — ran out of iteration budget after the first 10 items; bugs/pass above are the critical set the user asked about. Documented here so the next run can pick up exactly where we stopped:
- T2b tutorial entry from LineMeasurePanel 'Mehr' menu (the entry points from Mehr and from /help were not driven — only the tutorial-practice button and the ?practice=1 URL were).
- T3 Steps 7-9 (Wandhöhe eintragen, Öffnung einfügen, Öffnung verschieben): the 'Mehr' expand in LineMeasurePanel renders the word 'Mehr' in multiple places (coach card + panel); a click on the first 'Mehr' label does not expand the Wandhöhe accordion, step 7 stayed stuck. Needs a testID on the panel's Mehr toggle and on the Wandhöhe section header / input before this can be scripted reliably. The 'Höhe alle Linien' input needs a testID (e.g. wall-height-input or wall-height-all).
- T3 room-coach-skip, room-coach-toggle (collapse), room-coach-exit paths (buttons are present in DOM, not exercised live).
- T4 practice side-effects (real sketch state restored, nothing saved during practice).
- T5 390x844 phone viewport repeat of T3 steps 1-4.
- O3 overlap prevention, O4 drag on H/V lines, O5 Tür/Fenster/Sonstiges switch + copy to other line, O6 two-opening staggered labels + wall-area deduction after save/reload, O7 straightening preserves openings.

Zero PAGEERROR and zero CONSOLE[error] during the entire run.

ui_bugs.issue: LIVE-REPRODUCED. Typing '-0,5' into the offset field is silently accepted. wall-opening-conflict-0 remains empty and no warning is rendered. openingConflict() in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts only checks start+width > lineMeters ('outside' overshoot) and overlap — a start<0 branch is missing. Recommended fix: add `if (start < -0.005) return 'outside';` OR return a new conflict kind 'before_start' with a dedicated message, and/or clamp in openingOffsetMeters with Math.max(0, …).

LIVE-REPRODUCED. Typing non-numeric garbage ('abc') into the offset field is stored verbatim but parseMeasurementToMeters returns NaN → openingOffsetMeters null → no conflict indicator, no hint. Users receive zero feedback that their input is ignored. Recommended: render '⚠ Keine Zahl erkannt' under the field when parse fails (openingOffsetMeters === null && raw string is non-empty).

action_items: (HIGH) Fix O2 negative-offset gap in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts: openingConflict() must return a conflict for start<-0.005. Live-reproduced: draw a measured 4,00 line, insert a door, type '-0,5' into wall-opening-offset-0 → expected visible 'Ragt über die Linie hinaus' (or a new 'vor dem Linienanfang'), actual: no indicator, invalid value stored.
(MEDIUM) Add a user-visible hint under wall-opening-offset-i when the raw text fails to parse (openingOffsetMeters === null and text is non-empty). Currently 'abc' is silently accepted.

(MEDIUM) Add stable testIDs to drive the LineMeasurePanel Mehr menu: measure-panel-mehr-toggle, measure-panel-wall-height-section, wall-height-input-all, wall-height-input-<lineIdx>, measure-panel-close. Without these the main-agent self-test for T3 steps 7-9 and T4 practice side-effects cannot be scripted reliably — this run got stuck on step 7 because the word 'Mehr' appears in the coach text AND in the panel, and there is no deterministic selector for the panel's Mehr toggle.
(LOW) Add testID on the diagonal input (e.g. diagonal-input) and on the diagonal commit path so RoomCoach step 5 can be driven without a placeholder-based fallback.
(LOW) Confirm long-press duration: 900 ms with mouse.down → sleep → up works reliably at 768×1024. On phone size (390×844) this still needs to be verified in T5 (not executed in this run).
critical_code_review_comments: RoomCoach step 5 'Diagonale eingeben' auto-focus WORKS live (iter_70 concern rejected) — after step 4 the panel re-opens with the Diagonalen-angeben accordion expanded and the correct 'Ecke Linie X/Y ↔ Ecke Linie A/B' diagonal field focused. Keep the coach text as-is.

Orange glow (#ff6d00 box-shadow + 3px border + #fff3e0 bg) on highlighted toolbar buttons is correctly applied during the matching step (verified via DOM style read on point-move-only-toggle during step 4 and tool-polygon during step 1). Good.

The two offset-validation bugs reported in iter_70 (negative offset + non-numeric text) are LIVE-REPRODUCED and should be fixed together in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts openingConflict() and in WallHeightSection validation UI.

Everything that was code-reviewed as 'should work' in iter_70 and that was actually driven live here (auto tutorial 10-page carousel, key persistence, practice entry via tutorial button and via ?practice=1 URL, coach steps 1-6 including the diagonal auto-focus, straightening) WORKS live.

success_rate.frontend: LIVE-PASS 10 / LIVE-FAIL 2 / NOT-EXECUTED 6 of the 18 planned sub-items (T1, T2a, T2c, T3 steps 1-6, O1, O2 overshoot + comma parsing — all pass; O2 negative-offset + non-numeric-text — bugs, reproduced). Zero PAGEERROR. Zero CONSOLE[error].

seed_data_creation: Transient localStorage only (aufmassprofi_settings, aufmassprofi_customers [TEST_Max Muster/cust1], aufmassprofi_projects [TEST_Projekt/p1], aufmassprofi_pro_unlocked, aufmassprofi_tour_done, aufmassprofi_sketch_tour_done, app_language='de', aufmassprofi_room_tutorial_done — set/cleared per test). No sketches persisted to the aufmassprofi_sketches key. Nothing touched the user's real data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To finish the remaining 6 items, main agent should first add the testIDs listed in action_items (measure-panel-mehr-toggle, measure-panel-wall-height-section, wall-height-input-all, measure-panel-close, diagonal-input). With those in place: (1) T3 Step 7 Wandhöhe → click measure-panel-mehr-toggle, click measure-panel-wall-height-section, fill wall-height-input-all='2,5', press Enter → coach advances to step 8. (2) Step 8 Öffnung einfügen already PASSES via long-press + opening-insert-door (verified in O1); just chain it after Step 7. (3) Step 9 Öffnung verschieben → close panel (measure-panel-close) then mouse.down on opening-marker-0-0 and drag ~50px along the line → openingKey changes → step 9 done. (4) T4 side-effects: before entering practice via 'Mehr→Tutorial' draw a 2x2 rectangle (tool-rect + two canvas clicks), remember element count=1; enter practice from LineMeasurePanel Mehr menu; exit practice via room-coach-exit and assert aufmassprofi_sketches still shows element count=1 AND no 'practice' sketch was written. (5) T5 at 390×844: repeat steps 1-4 of T3 and screenshot the coach card compact mode; verify it does not overlap the toolbar tool with the orange glow at phone width. (6) O3-O7: build on the O1/O2 flow already proven to work — the wall-opening-copy-0 button, wall-opening-kind-{door,window,other}-0 buttons, and the two-openings-staggered-labels / save / reload / straighten steps all become straightforward once Mehr/Wandhöhe testIDs exist. Known good coords @ 768x1024: canvas box x=0 y=192 w=768 h=904; polygon vertices (200,250)(520,250)(520,490)(200,490); line midpoints top(360,250) right(520,370) bottom(360,490) left(200,370); long-press = mouse.down + 900ms + mouse.up; drag = 10-step mouse.move with 30ms pauses.
rca_of_issue: Both reproduced bugs sit in /app/frontend/src/sketch/wallArea.ts openingConflict() (approx. lines 47-59): the function only returns 'outside' when start+width > lineMeters, and never checks start<0; it never inspects the raw input string for parse failure. Repro for negative offset: insert any door, type '-0,5' into wall-opening-offset-0 — expected 'Ragt über die Linie hinaus' (or a new 'vor dem Linienanfang'), actual: empty wall-opening-conflict-0, value stored as '-0,5'. Repro for garbage text: same field, type 'abc' — expected a hint such as '⚠ Keine Zahl', actual: silently stored, conflict is empty. Mitigation: `if (start < -0.005) return 'outside';` in openingConflict and, in WallHeightSection, render a parse-failed hint when openingOffsetMeters === null and the input is non-empty.
